# Periapt of Proof against Poison (`magic-items:periapt-of-proof-against-poison`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you have Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Poison damage.
